name: Leadearly
what: London boutique offering admissions coaching for master's, MBA and EMBA programs in the UK and Europe, led by founder Sadaf Raza (INSEAD MBA, former INSEAD interviewer).
aud: Applicants to specialised master's programs (Finance, Management, Marketing, Economics), MBA and EMBA candidates, and some undergraduates
svc: Application strategy, essay coaching, interview preparation
prog: Masters in Finance, Management, Marketing and Economics (LSE, Imperial and others); MBA/EMBA at INSEAD, LBS, IESE, Bocconi, Imperial, Oxford, Cambridge, HEC Paris, TRIUM, ESCP
price: Not public
diff: Founder handles clients personally; claims a 98% success rate for placing applicants at their top choice; British Council certified
why: London-based coaching for UK and European business master's programs, the same customers PerformUp targets in the UK
notes: No GMAT/GRE tutoring found on the site. A second Facebook page also exists: https://www.facebook.com/leadearlyprogrammes

name: Admissions Parallèles
what: Paris prep and coaching firm dedicated to AST1/AST2 entry into grandes écoles, combining Tage Mage/TAGE 2/TOEIC training with dossier, essay and interview coaching and individual tutoring until admission.
aud: Bac+2/3/4 students targeting AST1/AST2, Tremplin/Passerelle and Sciences Po
svc: Tage Mage, TAGE 2, TOEIC prep; dedicated tutor for professional project; CV/cover letter/essay coaching; interview prep; ranked mock exams
prog: HEC, ESSEC, ESCP, emlyon, EDHEC, Audencia, KEDGE, TBS, SKEMA, NEOMA, GEM; Tremplin, Passerelle; Sciences Po/IEP
price: AST2 programmes from €450; AST1 distance from €1,150; dossier/oral-only variable
diff: "Admis ou remboursé" guarantee on 6-month+ programmes; 15+ years in AST; publishes a free AST guide and school-by-school SEO content
why: Direct mirror of PerformUp's promise including an admitted-or-refunded guarantee, on the same schools.
notes: Strong SEO footprint (ranks for school-specific AST queries such as ESSEC/ESCP MiM).

name: Hello Prépa (incl. Hello TAGE MAGE)
hq: France (Paris, 4 centres; also Lyon, Marseille, Lille, Bordeaux, Rennes, Nantes, Nice)
what: Large national prépa founded by two HEC Paris alumni covering post-bac and AST business school concours, with tiered AST2 packages mixing Tage Mage, TOEIC, dossier and oral coaching, plus the Hello TAGE MAGE e-learning/books brand.
aud: Post-bac students (Sésame/Accès/BBA) and Bac+2/3/4 AST candidates; also Sciences Po and engineering post-bac
svc: AST2 1/1.5/2-year programmes (Bronze/Silver/Gold); Tage Mage weekends and accelerated online prep; TOEIC; dossier & oral coaching; AST Max e-learning; best-selling Tage Mage books
prog: Top-20 French business schools incl. HEC, ESSEC, ESCP, EDHEC, emlyon, SKEMA, Audencia, NEOMA; Sésame, Accès, ESCP Bachelor, EDHEC BBA; Sciences Po/IEP
price: AST2 1-year in-person €2,290 (Bronze) / €2,590 (Silver) / €2,890 (Gold); 2-year Gold €3,890; accelerated online Tage Mage €790; scholarship rates and instalments
diff: "Admis ou remboursé" on all programmes; founders are influencer-style personalities (Joachim & Arnaud) with big social reach; claims 250+ top-5 admits and 20,000+ candidates prepared; official interview jurors as coaches
why: Most visible direct rival: same HEC-alumni founder story, same guarantee, same AST/MiM targets, strong social media.
notes: Founders also run personal accounts https://www.instagram.com/joachim_et_arnaud/ and https://www.tiktok.com/@joachim_et_arnaud, plus media site Monsieur Ecoles de Commerce. Hello TAGE MAGE site: https://www.hello-tage-mage.com.

name: Ipesup
what: Long-established Paris prépa running full admissions-parallèles programmes that bundle Tage Mage/TAGE 2 classes, individual dossier coaching and an intensive oral bootcamp for top French business schools.
aud: Bac+2 to Bac+4/5 students applying via AST/admissions parallèles or direct Master admission
svc: Tage Mage & TAGE 2 cycles/intensive stages; TOEIC/TOEFL; personalised dossier coaching with certified coach; 4-day oral prep with mock juries; HEC-specific interview prep; Score IAE-Message
prog: HEC, ESSEC, ESCP, emlyon, EDHEC, SKEMA, NEOMA, KEDGE, GEM, TBS, Audencia, IAE; also Tremplin/Passerelle prep
price: Admission Master programme €2,900 (standard) / €3,400 (reinforced); single Tage Mage stages €1,900–€2,900; TOEIC €690–€990; HEC interview prep €360
diff: Brand heritage and scale; claims 25% admitted to HEC/ESSEC/ESCP, 60% top-5, 95% top-10; in-person Paris + live online
why: Same end-to-end offer (test + dossier + oral) for the same top French business school masters, at similar price points.
notes: Group-based classes rather than pure 1:1. Shares address/group with Optimal Sup Spé (scientific prépa, not a competitor).

name: MyCursus
what: Paris admissions consultancy (since 2020) that coaches applications to French grandes écoles and international universities, from test prep to essays, CVs and interviews.
aud: Post-bac and Master applicants (French and international schools)
svc: Free orientation call; GMAT/Tage Mage, TOEFL/IELTS, SAT, Bocconi/IE/ESADE tests; essays, CVs, recommendation letters; interview coaching
prog: HEC, ESSEC, ESCP, emlyon, Polytechnique; LSE, UCL, King's, Bocconi, ESADE, IE, UvA, Cambridge; McGill, HEC Montréal; Parcoursup/UCAS
price: Not public
diff: Covers both French AST/MiM and international applications in one consultancy; 2,000+ students accompanied
why: Same consulting-style model (strategy + tests + essays + interviews) for MiM at HEC/ESSEC/ESCP and European schools.
notes: No socials linked on site; Instagram and LinkedIn confirmed via search.

name: Prepaya
what: Premium Paris institute (since 2012) for Tage Mage, GMAT, GRE and TOEIC, with unlimited dossier and interview coaching bundled into every package for French and international MiM applications.
aud: Students applying to French top-5 MiM via AST and to international masters (LBS, LSE, Bocconi, St. Gallen...)
svc: Tage Mage, GMAT, GRE, TOEIC prep; unlimited dossier & oral coaching; free mock tests; 2-year access; open 7 days 8am–midnight
prog: HEC, ESSEC, ESCP, emlyon, EDHEC, SKEMA, Dauphine, Sciences Po; LBS, LSE, Oxford Saïd, Imperial, Bocconi, St. Gallen, INSEAD
price: Tage Mage €2,900 all-inclusive; GMAT or GRE €4,180; bundles €5,180–€5,850
diff: Claims 82.1% of 2024/25 MiM cohort admitted to top-5; teachers ENS/X/HEC/ESSEC with GMAT 725+; dossier/oral unlimited in all packages
why: Nearly identical bundle to PerformUp (GMAT/GRE/Tage Mage + unlimited dossier/oral) for French and European MiM.
notes: TikTok handle @missionast_ linked on site; Instagram/LinkedIn confirmed via search. Has a Morocco branch.

name: Prepfection
what: Boutique founded in 2020 by ESCP/Dauphine alumni offering tiered AST2/MiM packages (Tage Mage, TOEIC, dossier, mock orals, school strategy) plus post-bac and international test prep.
aud: Bac+3/4 AST2 candidates; post-bac applicants; students targeting international bachelors/masters
svc: Tage Mage prep with mock tests; TOEIC/English; CV & dossier optimisation; up to 5 oral simulations; school strategy; GMAT/GRE/TOEFL; Bocconi/IE/ESADE tests
prog: HEC, ESSEC, ESCP, EDHEC, emlyon, NEOMA, TBS, GEM, SKEMA, Audencia; Accès/Sésame; IE, ESADE, Bocconi
price: AST2/MiM: Essentiel €1,490 (28h) / Complet €2,890 (55h) / Excellence €3,990 (80h)
diff: "Admis ou remboursé" option; reinforced 1:1 follow-up with lead coach; claims 95% success, 500+ students
why: Small coach-led boutique with a refund guarantee and France + international scope, very close to PerformUp's positioning.
notes: Social URLs shown on site without https prefix (instagram.com/prepfection, linkedin.com/company/prepfection).

name: Prépa Campus
what: Paris AST prépa built on individualised and small-group coaching across Tage Mage, academic dossier, English tests and motivation interviews.
aud: AST candidates aiming at top French business schools
svc: 1:1 and small-group Tage Mage; TOEFL/TOEIC/IELTS; dossier coaching; interview prep; 24/7 follow-up via WhatsApp
prog: HEC, ESSEC, ESCP, emlyon, EDHEC, Audencia and other top schools
price: Not public
diff: "Admissible ou remboursé" guarantee; claims 100% of students enter one of their top-3 choices; 25+ coaches
why: Individualised 1:1 AST coaching with a refund-style guarantee, same schools.
notes: Instagram handle @prepacampus referenced on site; no other socials found. Runs an SEO blog on Tage Mage.

name: Prépa Laurea
what: Small Paris prépa founded by ESCP and ESSEC alumni preparing AST2 candidates with live Tage Mage classes, dossier coaching and long-format mock interviews.
aud: AST2 / Master candidates to top French business schools; also Sciences Po and application dossiers for MSc/MS/MBA
svc: Tage Mage (56h or 112h, live + replay, 10 mock tests); CV/cover letter/essay coaching; 4 oral simulations; TOEIC; orientation strategy
prog: HEC, ESSEC, ESCP, EDHEC, emlyon, SKEMA (AST2); dossiers for PGE, MSc, MS, Masters, MBA
price: Complete programme €2,625 (1 yr) / €2,925 (2 yrs); Tage Mage only €1,650–€1,950; dossier €450–€1,350; oral €975

why: Alumni-founded, test + dossier + oral package for the same schools and price band.
notes: No social links on site; LinkedIn confirmed via search. Instagram not confirmed.

name: Apex GMAT (now Focus Tutoring)
what: Premium 1:1 GMAT/GRE tutoring firm using 99th-percentile tutors, now also offering MBA admissions consulting; apexgmat.com redirects to focustutoring.com.
aud: High-achieving MBA applicants aiming at top schools, incl. London and other global cities
svc: 1:1 online and in-person tutoring (GMAT, GRE, EA, LSAT); diagnostic; MBA admissions consulting (essays, interviews); stamina/test-anxiety coaching
prog: GMAT Focus, GRE, Executive Assessment, LSAT; MBA admissions (incl. Oxbridge)
price: Online from ~$375/h; in-person from ~$475/h; pay-as-you-go, no fixed packages (reported)
diff: Top-1% tutors only (770+ old GMAT); dual-instructor model; 33+ global locations incl. London
why: Premium 1:1 GMAT tutoring plus admissions consulting for top schools: same model as PerformUp, with a London presence.
notes: Rebranded/redirected to focustutoring.com. No public guarantee; pricing from search results.

name: GMAT Ninja
what: Boutique firm of experienced tutors offering private GMAT/GRE/EA tutoring and hourly MBA admissions consulting; big free YouTube following.
aud: MBA applicants worldwide who want senior 1:1 tutors
svc: Private tutoring; hourly admissions consulting; performance/test-anxiety coaching; MBA profile evaluation; self-paced course launching Fall 2026
prog: GMAT Focus, GRE, Executive Assessment; MBA admissions
price: $320/h with most tutors, $420/h with founder; 2-hour sessions; no packages
diff: Founded 2002; explicitly refuses score guarantees; well known for free YouTube content and GMAT Club presence
why: Combines 1:1 GMAT tutoring with admissions consulting, the same bundle PerformUp sells, delivered online to Europe.

name: Manhattan Prep (powered by Kaplan)
what: Kaplan-owned GMAT/GRE brand selling live online classes, on-demand courses and private 1:1 tutoring with 99th-percentile instructors. Kaplan's own GMAT offer is now marketed under the Manhattan Prep name.
aud: Global MBA/MiM/grad-school applicants, incl. Europe (Kaplan has London presence)
svc: Live online GMAT courses; on-demand course; private tutoring packages (10-30h); official practice tests; adaptive study platform
prog: GMAT Focus, GRE, Executive Assessment (also LSAT, SAT, ACT, TOEFL)
price: Kaplan/Manhattan GMAT (third-party reported 2026): Complete live course ~$1,600 (list $1,999); Advanced ~$1,400; On Demand ~$850; tutoring 10h ~$2,560 to 30h ~$6,600
diff: Higher Score Guarantee: 655+ (if baseline 585+) or +70 points, or money back; big brand plus Kaplan scale
why: Its 30h private tutoring package is the closest like-for-like to PerformUp's 30h+ 1:1 GMAT coaching, backed by a global brand and a score guarantee.
notes: Merged with the Kaplan entry (kaptest.com/gmat now redirects to Manhattan Prep branding). LinkedIn is Kaplan Test Prep's (no separate Manhattan Prep page found). Kaplan main IG: https://www.instagram.com/kaplantestprep/ ; YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/user/kaplantestprep. X link on site points to Kaplan's corporate news account. Pricing from third-party reviews (kaptest.com returned 403).

name: Manhattan Review
what: International test-prep firm offering GMAT/GRE group classes and private tutoring in many cities, plus admissions consulting for MBA and grad programs.
aud: Working professionals and students applying to MBA/Masters, with strong European city coverage
svc: Group courses; private tutoring in person or online; admissions consulting; prep books
prog: GMAT, GRE (also LSAT, SAT, ACT, TOEFL, IELTS); MBA/grad admissions
price: 12-hour GMAT private course $1,590 (Frankfurt, Madrid, Milan, Paris listings); otherwise not public
diff: Physical tutoring in many European cities (London, Paris via review.fr, Frankfurt, Zurich, Milan, Madrid); curriculum by business-school professor Joern Meissner
why: Delivers GMAT tutoring plus admissions consulting locally in Paris, Milan, Madrid etc.: direct competition in PerformUp's home markets.
notes: Socials from manhattanreview.co.uk footer; also general accounts facebook.com/ManhattanReview and twitter.com/ManhattanReview. French site: review.fr. Not to be confused with Manhattan Prep.

name: Vincia Prep
what: Paris-based boutique prep center offering GMAT/GRE/Tage Mage tutoring and group courses, plus MBA/Masters essay and interview coaching.
aud: French and international students applying to MBA, Masters and PhD programs
svc: Private tutoring (online/in Paris); GMAT group courses; free diagnostic test; essay and interview coaching
prog: GMAT, GRE, Tage Mage, TOEFL, IELTS; MBA/Masters applications
price: Not public (quote on request; limited to ~10 new students/month)
diff: Beat the GMAT-certified teachers; chosen by Ecole Polytechnique (2018); guarantee of free extra lessons if score does not improve
why: Paris-based, covers GMAT + Tage Mage + essays/interviews for the same French business-school applicants as PerformUp.
notes: No social links on site; LinkedIn (~22 followers) and Facebook confirmed via search. Address 46 rue Saint-Antoine, Paris. Founded ~2010.

name: MiM Prep
what: London-based boutique that coaches pre-experience applicants through MiM, MiF and some MBA/bachelor applications, using current students and alumni of the target schools as tutors.
aud: Undergraduates and recent graduates (many French/European) targeting top MiM/MiF programs; also LSE bachelor's applicants
svc: GMAT strategy with in-house tutors and an AI GMAT platform; CV and essays with unlimited edits; recommendation guidance; school selection; unlimited mock interviews with alumni of the target school; selection-committee simulation
prog: MiM, MiF, MBA, bachelor's. Schools: LBS (MiM, MFA), HEC Paris (MiM, M2M HEC-Yale, HEC-Polytechnique), ESSEC, ESCP, INSEAD, Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, plus US schools. Tests: GMAT
price: Not public (payment in instalments offered)
diff: '5 experts for every application step', 60+ hours per application, limited cohort; says 30+ students made the 2025 LBS MiM class (over 10% of it) and 86% placed in their top 2 choices
why: Almost a mirror of PerformUp: MiM-first, GMAT plus application plus unlimited mocks, same target schools (HEC/ESSEC/ESCP/LBS/INSEAD), tutors are school insiders.
notes: Address 86-90 Paul Street, London. Site copy says 'guarantee admission' but no formal refund guarantee was found. Team is largely young HEC/LBS/ESCP/ESSEC students and alumni. Closest direct competitor in this segment.

name: MiM-Essay
what: MiM-focused application consultancy staffed by MiM graduates of top schools, offering low-priced packages and a large SEO content library on European MiMs.
aud: Indian and international pre-experience applicants to MiM programs (also some MBA/MS)
svc: School selection (dream/competitive/safe), brainstorming, essays with unlimited edits, resume, LORs, 2 mock interviews per school, post-admit help (scholarships, loans, visa)
prog: MiM and related masters. Schools: HEC Paris, ESCP, LBS, ESSEC, LSE, INSEAD, Oxford, Cambridge, US schools
price: Core Pack INR 19,999; All-in-One INR 29,999; Founders Support INR 44,999 (base prices, scale with number of schools; up to 25% off for 4+ schools; USD pricing available)
diff: All consultants hold a MiM; '5-school guarantee' (2 extra schools mentored free if no admit) plus a 10-day money-back guarantee; very large blog and school-guide footprint
why: Pure MiM positioning on HEC/ESCP/LBS/ESSEC with a guarantee; competes heavily for organic search traffic on European MiM topics.
notes: India location inferred from its +91 contact number and INR pricing. Content and SEO competitor on 'HEC MiM', 'ESCP MiM fees' and similar queries.

name: Menlo Coaching
what: Premium admissions consultancy for MBA and specialized business masters, with integrated test tutoring and a strong European team.
aud: MBA and pre-experience/early-career masters applicants targeting top US and European schools
svc: Full application coaching, school selection, essays, interview prep, career-goal development, integrated GMAT/GRE tutoring
prog: MBA, MiM, MiF, MFE, Business Analytics masters. Schools: HEC Paris, LBS, INSEAD, LSE, St. Gallen, Bocconi, ESADE, Oxford, Cambridge, IESE, MIT, Yale, Columbia and others
price: Hourly USD 500; 'Menlo 21' USD 9,500 for 21 hours; Comprehensive custom-priced (no hour cap)
diff: Max ~15 clients per coach a year; ex-admissions officers (incl. former IESE Director of Admissions Pascal Michels) and MBB consultants; career and recruiting focus. Explicitly no money-back or admission guarantee
why: Dedicated business-masters line covering PerformUp's exact schools (HEC, LBS, LSE, St. Gallen, Bocconi), with in-house test tutoring.
notes: Priced well above PerformUp. Its 'no guarantee' stance contrasts with PerformUp's 'Admitted or Refunded'.

name: Your Dream School

prog: MiM, LLM and other masters; bachelor's (UCAS, Common App, Studielink, CAO). Schools: HEC Paris, ESSEC, ESCP, LBS, LSE, Bocconi, IE, ESADE, Imperial, UCL, Ivy League

diff: Audited results (since 2018: 8 admitted to HEC Paris, 32 to ESCP, 14 to ESSEC, 9 to LSE); 1,000+ students; 160+ five-star Google reviews; published book and French press coverage; support with re-applications if initial choices don't admit
why: Same French market and the same MiM schools (HEC/ESSEC/ESCP/LSE/Bocconi), with TAGE MAGE/GMAT prep and a bachelor's line.
notes: Also fits a French-competitor segment; check for duplicates if that segment is compiled separately. Covered in Le Point and L'Etudiant.
